  (c) --ours /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K3-reg-02/frames/idle/S --label idle_S_K3 --fps 8 --out oracle/bands_idle.json --plot_dir /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/oracle/plots

Then run the FULL suite: `cd astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected all green except the four named T0-d3 reds; report exact counts.

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T1a-idle-2"): files = every created/modified file with sha256 (absolute paths under astra_test_01/burst); images []; calls_used 0; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns must name precisely anything not met, with numbers, the estimator you chose and why, AND the measured summary for combat / relaxed / idle_S_K3 (period s, breath amplitude %H, head bob %H, contamination, eps/floor derived, LOCK, MOTION, moving_count).
